fin.internationalNote: Cal State LA non-resident direct billed cost $41,838 (2026-27) — ⚠ THE ONE DERIVED FIGURE IN THIS CAMPAIGN; read the basis before changing it. Tier-1 from Cal State LA Financial Aid's official 2026-2027 Cost of Attendance table (Undergraduate, On Campus): tuition and mandatory fees $7,938 + housing $13,682 + food $7,972. That table is labelled 'CA Resident TOTAL' and Cal State LA publishes NO non-resident total — only the statewide surcharge of $471 a unit. The surcharge is annualised here at 26 units ($12,246), which is the basis its sister CSU campus Fullerton publishes for the identical $471 rate (13 units a semester), giving tuition $20,184. A 24-unit floor would be $11,304 (−$942) and a 30-unit load $14,130 (+$1,884), so the plausible band is roughly $40,900–$43,700. The previous stored $28,000 was an unresearched ballpark and understated the cost by $13,838, far more than the width of that band — which is why the derivation was made rather than deferred. Replace it the moment Cal State LA publishes a non-resident budget. LA living costs are high; D2 athletic aid plus need-based aid is the realistic package.
